messages.author: 943f0daf148b8e6b
messages.subject: batchfiles 0-7.1 and  ProcessStart using Rscript
parts:
With batchfiles_0.6-6 I was able to use Rscript.bat to run Rscript.exe in R using the ProcessStartInfo command as shown below (using VS2012).

However, the batchfiles_0.7-1 upgrade removes the Rscript.bat file and states that "the functionality is now available again integrated into R.bat". Despite my best efforts, I have been unable to see how to use the 0.7-1 R.bat file in place of the 0.6-6 Rscript.bat file in the ProcessStartInfo command below.

Can anyone please clarify how to run Rscript.exe on a windows server where the path to R may change on different servers?

Many thanks and apologies for any lack of understanding.
RNE
ps the batchfiles are in the bin folder of an asp.net website

string inputs = rprogpath + " " + nunits + " " + seed + " " + strata + " " + blocklevelsstring +
" " + String.Join(",", treatslist) + " " + String.Join(",", repslist);
string[] outdata;
string r = Server.MapPath("/").Replace("\\", "/") + "bin/Rscript.bat";
using (var si = new Process())
{
si.StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo(r, inputs)
{
UseShellExecute = false,
RedirectStandardOutput = true
};
si.Start();
string outputs = si.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
si.WaitForExit(1000000);
outdata = outputs.Split(' ');
}

messages.subject: Re: batchfiles 0-7.1 and  ProcessStart using Rscript
parts:
This is supposed to work:

   R script myscript.bat 

but if that does not work for you then I suggest you just grab Rscript.bat from an older version of batchfiles.  The scripts are self contained and independent so there should be no problem in mixing scripts from different versions.
